nodes.text:
🟠Human metapneumovirus (#HMPV) cases have surged in parts of #China, especially among children under 14, leading to overcrowded hospitals and increased public concern. 
Neighboring countries are monitoring the situation, and #Nigerian health authorities have classified the risk

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text: The rise in cases has been observed in northern #China, with hospitals overwhelmed in cities like Hangzhou. Neighboring countries, including #Cambodia, #Taiwan, and #HongKong, have also reported cases.

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
In #Nigeria, preparedness measures are in focus, despite no reported cases.
